title: Sobha — Risk & Reputation Research
content:
According to reviews, Sobha's customer service receives mixed feedback. Common complaints include slow response to maintenance requests, higher-than-expected service charges, and occasional gaps in community management. Specific issues mentioned are higher maintenance charges (₹3-4 per sq ft versus industry average of ₹2-3 per sq ft), limited parking spaces, and delays in amenity completion. Some reviews highlight unprofessional behavior from management staff, while others commend specific individuals for their helpfulness. Despite these complaints, 85% of customers still recommend Sobha to others.

Post-possession service quality varies across Sobha communities. While 85% of customers still recommend Sobha to others, maintenance and after-sales service receives mixed reviews. ### What are common complaints about Sobha projects?

We are now two months post-handover, and I am STILL unable to move into my own apartment.After waiting an additional year for delivery, I am now facing further delays because of Sobha’s unnecessarily difficult NOC approval process. My interior design company has manufactured all my custom-made furniture, my contractors are ready to proceed, and installation remains on hold while I attempt to obtain clear technical guidance and the necessary approvals.I currently have no alternative [...] For a developer positioning itself as a premium luxury brand, the standard of customer service and after-sales support I have experienced has been exceptionally disappointing.  
1. Apartment delivered 12 months late  
My apartment was handed over approximately 12 months after the original handover date stipulated in my Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA). [...] I requested my refund in January 2026. Since then I have been met with delays, broken promises, and eventually complete silence. In April 2026, a member of their Sales Operations team emailed me to say the refund had been processed and would arrive within 3-4 working days. It is now May 2026 and nothing has arrived. They cannot even provide a transaction reference number.  
I have filed a formal complaint with RERA and the Dubai Land Department. I am now pursuing legal action.

What is SOBHA's after-sales service quality?  
SOBHA operates in-house customer service teams handling post-handover defect resolution, warranty claims, and society management transitions. Service quality is generally strong, with typical defect resolution within 7-30 days depending on issue complexity. [...] Prospective buyers can evaluate SOBHA's after-sales service quality through several practical approaches. Talk to residents of delivered projects — visit delivered SOBHA projects and engage residents in informal conversations about service experience. Review society management audit reports — established SOBHA project RWAs typically maintain audit reports of service quality. Check online review patterns — review platforms often include post-handover service feedback. Engage with resident [...] What happens if SOBHA does not resolve a defect?  
Issues not resolved within standard timelines can be escalated through customer service coordinator, regional customer service head, and corporate leadership. RERA dispute resolution is available for unresolved defect-related disputes, providing legal recourse.

Additionally, the Karnataka High Court dismissed writ petitions filed by Sobha Developers Ltd, finding no merit in their contentions.

Sobha Realty has faced significant criticism from customers regarding hidden issues, poor communication, and a lack of responsibility. Reviews on Trustpilot highlight a lack of transparency and accountability, with unanswered emails and ignored promises. Customers also report deceptive practices, including profiting from purchases while refusing to apply promised discounts. Another review mentions high entry prices, limited community diversity, and a lack of post-handover options. Overall, the sources indicate a pattern of unprofessional behavior and lack of customer service.

Sobha’s reputation for “luxury” does not match the reality we experienced. Instead of professionalism, we encountered hidden issues, poor communication, and a total absence of responsibility.  
⚠️ I strongly advise anyone considering Sobha to proceed with extreme caution. [...] Even worse than the financial discrepancies has been the lack of transparency and accountability. Emails go unanswered, promises are ignored, and customer service feels careless and unprofessional. For a company that presents itself as a premium, international developer, this level of support is shocking. [...] This isn’t just poor customer service — it’s deceptive. They profited from my purchase and then refused to apply the discount that influenced my decision to buy in the first place.  
If you are considering buying from Sobha Realty, be warned: they are not transparent, they do not act in good faith, and once they have your money, they will hide behind excuses rather than honour their commitments.  
I strongly advise anyone thinking about investing with Sobha Realty to reconsider.

### Cons:

- High Entry Price: Starting prices per square foot are higher than JVC, Arjan, or Al Furjan.
- Limited Community Diversity: Their primary Dubai footprint is concentrated in MBR City and Ras Al Khor.
- Lack of Post-Handover Options: Less leverage for short-term speculative investors who rely on post-completion payment terms.

## Conclusion

If you don’t reply to their messages within a second, expect even more spam. They claim their projects will see a 20% price increase per year but can’t provide any contracts to back up those claims. They were completely unable to answer my questions and just kept pushing the sale instead.  
  
I do not recommend doing business with them. They come across as desperate and unprofessional, with nothing to support their outrageous promises. Avoid at all costs! [...] Absolutely terrible experience. They called me 3-4 times an hour, totaling 9 calls in a single day! To top it off, they also spammed my WhatsApp, sending overly nice messages but offering zero real information about their projects. All they seem to care about is pushing prices and trying to force a sale. [...] Horrible hospitality
